# ipam_allocation (Data Source)

Reads one existing allocation by pool and ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright 2026 Appvia Ltd.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

variable "allocation_id" {
  type = string
}

data "ipam_allocation" "vnet" {
  pool = "uks"
  id   = var.allocation_id
}

output "vnet_cidr" {
  value = data.ipam_allocation.vnet.cidr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Allocation ID.
- `pool` (String) Pool ID.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) The allocated CIDR.
- `created_at` (String) When the allocation was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of `cidr`.
